title: Message list
responsibility: Shows conversation entries with authors, timestamps, optional status details and entity-reference links.

inputs.name: MessageList.messages
inputs.description: Required entries in display order. User names fall back to You; other authors display their provider followed by CLI, or Harness. Optional pending state, note, detail and version are displayed.

inputs.name: MessageList.workspace
inputs.description: Workspace for resolving references within the shown project and revision.

inputs.name: MessageList.entity
inputs.description: Optional viewed entity for reference resolution before the catalog lists it; defaults to null.

outputs.name: MessageList
outputs.description: Polite live list with author badges, formatted timestamps and reference-aware text. Shows pending styling and optional note/detail/design version. Empty lists prompt a conversation about the design.
